description: This file contains shell script code for setting up, testing, and manipulating git references and hooks, specifically for testing the processing of all refs with custom hooks in a git workflow.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case that expects success for the given script block.

methods.name: git update-ref
methods.description: Updates or creates git refs with specified commits.

methods.name: git -C ... config
methods.description: Configures git settings within a specified directory.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a git hook for testing purposes.

methods.name: test-tool proc-receive
methods.description: Simulates the 'proc-receive' hook behavior with specified arguments.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats and saves expected output for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares current refs to expected refs.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes raw output for consistent comparison.
